expected_results: DARK/default-OFF: both recovery flags OFF => established={'enabled': False}, no candidates, no mutation. With the established flag on but no allow-list configured => zero candidates (allowlist_empty).

Dedicated threshold default 900 (byte-identical); a configured 600 affects recovery eligibility ONLY and leaves analytics.equity_snapshots.DEFAULT_FRESHNESS_S and execution.monitoring_enrolment.SNAPSHOT_FRESHNESS_S at 900; malformed/zero/negative/<300s fail closed to 900.

Allow-list: missing/empty/malformed => zero candidates; a 50-only list selects #50 and excludes siblings (skipped_allowlist); #46/#48 (copier) stay excluded even if listed; membership never bypasses eligibility/identity/endpoint gates.

Host circuit breaker: a second relaunch inside the per-host rolling window is blocked (attempt-based budget — a FAILING relaunch still consumes it); >HOST_MAX_DOWN concurrent siblings down blocks that host cohort; a different host is unaffected; a cohort-query failure or malformed config fails closed (blocks); expired-window evidence allows a later recovery.

One decision per account per pass; a repeat/concurrent pass cannot duplicate a relaunch (select_for_update claim + cooldown + allow-list re-check under the lock). is_active is never changed; no order/credential/login/Copy-Trading action.

Latency evidence: unavailable cross-cycle measurements are null (never 0); the first identity-matched read AT-OR-AFTER the relaunch is used; no fabricated snapshot; p50/p95 not claimed (documented gap).
